title: Moon 0.4.3 beta
notes:
[Download Moon for Mac](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/releases/download/v0.4.3-beta/Moon-0.4.3-arm64.dmg)

One installer for Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. The same signed DMG powers installation and in-app updates.

- Avoid repeated setup of unchanged page scripts while preserving script-world and settings invalidation.
- Show a ready first frame immediately, removing the previous 120 ms opacity animation. Sleeping previews clear at first paint.
- Cancel obsolete recovery work; slow active navigations can finish without a recovery restart.
- Simplify the sidebar dock to Extensions, Bookmarks, Downloads, Translate and Orbit. Swipe right on the sidebar to open the New Space card. Existing profiles and spaces are preserved.
- In three paired local runs (33 warm samples per version), median native command-to-request delay changed from 16.1 to 12.2 ms; WebKit first contentful paint stayed around 28 ms. These are controlled local measurements, not a general internet-speed claim.
- The installed build rendered 3840 × 2160 images and H.264 video. A five-second foreground check produced 145 frame callbacks, about 29 fps from a 30 fps source. Streaming tiers, HDR and DRM services depend on the source and hardware.
- Full local regression suite: 503 checks passed, one existing WebKit check skipped. See the [performance report](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/blob/main/Docs/PERFORMANCE.md) for measurements and limits.

Installed app approximately 11.31 MB; download approximately 5.09 MB. Personal browsing data and test media are excluded.

This beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. GitHub's automatic source-code links contain source, not extra app installers.
